title: Roasted Zucchini
description: Roasted zucchini seasoned with garlic, cayenne, and lemon cooked until caramelized and golden crisp for a delicious summer squash side dish.
ingredients: 1 pinch salt and ground black pepper to taste
1 pinch sea salt flakes to taste

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Place a rimmed baking sheet in the oven to heat up.
Place zucchini in a bowl. Add oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and cayenne; toss to coat.
Carefully remove the hot baking sheet and spray lightly with cooking spray. Spread out zucchini in an even layer without overcrowding.
Roast in the preheated oven until golden brown and crisped, turning halfway, about 20 minutes. Squeeze lemon juice on top and garnish with parsley. Sprinkle sea salt on top to taste.

video.description: In this video, you'll learn how to make delicious roasted zucchini, a simple and customizable side dish. Perfect for using up an abundance of zucchini from your garden! Join us as we guide you through the easy steps to create this flavorful dish. With just a handful of ingredients and 20 minutes of roasting time, you'll have tender and caramelized zucchini strips. Finish it off with a squeeze of lemon juice, a sprinkle of fresh parsley, and a pinch of sea salt flakes for the perfect finishing touch. Watch the video and enjoy this versatile and tasty roasted zucchini recipe!
